newsitem.title: USA: Dreyfus Corp names fund manager, research director.
newsitem.headline: Dreyfus Corp names fund manager, research director.

text.p: Dreyfus Corp on Thursday said it appointed Timothy Ghriskey as portfolio manager of the Dreyfus Fund Inc and Richard Hoey as director of equity research.
Ghriskey was head of value equities, which entailed the management of several funds, since joining Dreyfus in 1995, the company said.
Hoey was a portfolio manager and chief economist for Dreyfus since 1991, the company said.
Ernest Wiggins, who was portfolio manager of the Dreyfus Fund since 1995 and director of equity research since 1996, is leaving the company to join Equitable Securities, Dreyfus said.
